class.name: OcgBrepoffsetapiThrusections
class.brief_description: Describes functions to build a loft. This is a shell or a solid passing through a set of sections in a given sequence. Usually sections are wires, but the first and the last sections may be vertices (punctual sections).
class.description: ! Describes functions to build a loft. This is a shell or a ! solid passing through a set of sections in a given ! sequence. Usually sections are wires, but the first and ! the last sections may be vertices (punctual sections).

method.name: BRepOffsetAPI_ThruSections
method.description: Initializes an algorithm for building a shell or a solid passing through a set of sections, where: - isSolid is set to true if the construction algorithm is required to build a solid or to false if it is required to build a shell (the default value), - ruled is set to true if the faces generated between the edges of two consecutive wires are ruled surfaces or to false (the default value) if they are smoothed out by approximation, - pres3d defines the precision criterion used by the approximation algorithm; the default value is 1.0e-6. Use AddWire and AddVertex to define the successive sections of the shell or solid to be built.

method.name: Init
method.description: Initializes this algorithm for building a shell or a solid passing through a set of sections, where: - isSolid is set to true if this construction algorithm is required to build a solid or to false if it is required to build a shell. false is the default value; - ruled is set to true if the faces generated between the edges of two consecutive wires are ruled surfaces or to false (the default value) if they are smoothed out by approximation, - pres3d defines the precision criterion used by the approximation algorithm; the default value is 1.0e-6. Use AddWire and AddVertex to define the successive sections of the shell or solid to be built.

method.name: AddWire
method.description: Adds the wire wire to the set of sections through which the shell or solid is built. Use the Build function to construct the shape.

method.name: AddVertex
method.description: Adds the vertex Vertex (punctual section) to the set of sections through which the shell or solid is built. A vertex may be added to the set of sections only as first or last section. At least one wire must be added to the set of sections by the method AddWire. Use the Build function to construct the shape.

method.name: CheckCompatibility
method.description: Sets/unsets the option to compute origin and orientation on wires to avoid twisted results and update wires to have same number of edges.

method.description: if Ruled Returns the Face generated by each edge except the last wire if smoothed Returns the Face generated by each edge of the first wire

method.name: SetMutableInput
method.description: Sets the mutable input state. If true then the input profile can be modified inside the thrusection operation. Default value is true.

method.name: Generated
method.description: Returns a list of new shapes generated from the shape S by the shell-generating algorithm. This function is redefined from BRepBuilderAPI_MakeShape::Generated. S can be an edge or a vertex of a given Profile (see methods AddWire and AddVertex).

method.name: Wires
method.description: Returns the list of original wires

method.name: GetStatus
